Bayesian networks are a powerful tool for power system reliability analysis.

Bayesian networks can be used for the following: 1) reliability evaluation of power supply systems, 2) risk analysis of power supply systems and 3) reliability and risk analysis of energy systems.

the development of a methodology for the reliability analysis of power system networks.
the development of Bayesian network based on reliability block diagram (RBD).
